notes.title: Update note - Free demo ver.0.3
notes.content:
1. Add Artifacts that can cause petrification, freezing, burning and other attribute effects on monsters. Players can get a variety of Artifacts in the level to build the effects.
2.And now, players can permanently grow players' attributes (weapon atk、critical hit rate、reload time、 magazine capacity、etc..) by consuming energy to reduce the difficulty of the game.
3.Add "Camp", where players can consume golds to buy weapons in the tomb.

notes.title: Update note - Free demo ver. 0.2
notes.content:
1.In order to facilitate players to change weapons and operate mechanisms, [b][u]we have eliminated the gravity of weapons and greatly shortened the time required to release weapons.[/u][/b] Which means the weapon will not automatically return to the belt after releasing it, but the operation logic of players actively hanging weapons on the belt has not changed.

2.As it is easier to release the weapon, players may forget the weapon on the ground when pulling the basket lever before entering the ancient tomb. Therefore, [b][u]the initial weapon delivery place was changed to the first room of the ancient tomb.[/u][/b]

3. Fix some bugs.

notes.title: Update note - Free Demo Ver. 0.1
notes.content:
[b]Version Description:[/b]
[list]
[*] The purpose of this version is to collect player feedback, and the details of gameplay design and art quality will be updated continuously.
[*] Levels: 3 levels, including 1 boss level.
[*] Weapons: 5 guns, 1 artifact.
[*] For the purpose of testing, the gold coins and energy resources owned by players will not be cleared temporarily after they die in the game.
[/list]

[b]Gamepaly Instruction:[/b]
[list]
[*] Press the trigger button on the handle to shoot.
[*] Use the grip button of the handle to grab items and activate mechanisms. Buti If you have a weapon in your hand, you cannot capture items or activate mechanisms.
[*] The left and right belts can be hung with a gun respectively. Take the weapon near the belt and press the grip button of the handle to hang the weapon.Or keep pressing the grip button, then the gun in your hand will automatically hang on your belt.
[*] When the gun need reload, the magazine will ejected automatically. At this time, touch the ammunition bag in your chest then it can reload automatically. Or you can press the button A or X on the handle, so the magazine can be ejected in advance.
[*] Press the Y button of the handle to open the setting menu, and set the game language, player height, left/right hand movement mode, movement mask, etc.
[/list]

tags.bug: For the purpose of testing, the gold coins and energy resources owned by players will not be cleared temporarily after they die in the game.
